answer: Arrival-shape admission filter: new agents pass a randomized silent interval, then emit a sparse jittered heartbeat. The gate compares each identity's inter-arrival curve to a hollow cohort baseline and rejects clones before action. Near-identical early traffic sits in a quarantine vault, costing attackers one queue slot per profile. Mass registration spans weeks and shows a flat tundra of synchronized arrivals, so each identity pays wait time plus slot rent.
